headline: UK and EU Agree Reset Framework as Bilateral Trade Talks Continue
summary: The United Kingdom and European Union confirmed agreement on a reset framework, though discussions will continue on unresolved topics like university fees. The UK Chamber of Shipping called for the process to reduce cross-border regulatory burdens and shipping costs.
why: Trade and movement agreements between the UK and EU set compliance costs and tariff structures for cross-border supply chains following Brexit.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: Ongoing bilateral negotiations aim to reduce trade costs and regulatory hurdles for British logistics and businesses.
